summary: This plugin is for DSH plugin gate/clinic workflows, providing pre-install static checks, post-install verification, local peer fingerprinting, and optional GitHub lookups to help screen plugins.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is a DSH-facing automation utility for plugin supply-chain screening, centered on pre/post install checks rather than code generation or user-facing UI work. It is described as doing static audits, hash/capability verification, optional peer matching via GitHub, and detox-style transformations, which supports an install-guard/clinic workflow. Risk is moderate because it can influence install decisions and performs network lookups, but evidence also says it avoids executing the target plugin.
